PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Dr. Hashim Sulieman

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Almogadam Multi Activities Company Ltd, overseeing its Global Mining and Global Health businesses. An occupational medicine physician, healthcare professional and business leader with more than 15 years of experience in occupational health and safety, complemented by expertise in business development, management and organisational leadership across Europe, Africa and the Middle East.
